nodes.description: This service allows online booking of permits for visiting Gir Jungle Safari, GIZ Devalia Safari, Ambardi Safari Park, and Girnar Nature Safari.

sources.evidence: The 'e-Permit' is for a visit to 'Gir Jungle Safari', 'GIZ Devalia Safari', 'Ambardi Safari Park' and 'Girnar Nature Safari' only.

Who is eligible to qualify as IBR welder ?
A:
Qualification & experience requirements is mentioned in Regulation 608 of IBR 1950. Those fulfilling these criterias are eligible to apply for welder qualification test.

Can a welder work fue lance after getting welder certificate. Yes, He has to maintain
records as per Reg.No. 615 of IBr-1950.

What Preparation is needed before offering welder qualification test ?
A:
All materials like plate, pipe, tube of IBR quality &size as mentioned in Reg. 609 (B) of IBR-1950 is to be kept ready with relevant materials test certificate in original for verification.

What Type of welder test is conducted ?
A:
There is two type of welder qualification test
Initial welder qualification test
Welder RE-qualification test.

What is Form XII ?
A:
Form XII is prescribed form as per IBR-1950. All the Details of welder are to be filled in this form & submitted to local IBR office.

Can a IBR qualified welder of one state, work in other state ?
A:
Yes, This is possible after getting endorsement on original welder certificate by CIB of other state. Endorsement fees as per regulation 616 is to be paid.

nodes.name: Electrical Contractor License
nodes.description: A person can obtain an electrical contractor license if they have an electrical supervisor permit or employ someone with such a permit.

eligibility: A person must have one year of experience under a certified electrician or engineer to appear in the wireman examination.
A person must have six months of practical experience after completing a wireman apprentice course to appear in the wireman examination.
A person must have completed a one-year course in electrician or related fields to appear in the wireman examination.
A person must have completed a one-year course in electrician at Rajkot to appear in the wireman examination.
A person must have completed a six-month course in motor winding to appear in the wireman examination.
A person must have passed the wireman examination and have four years of experience to appear in the supervisor examination.

sources.evidence:

C. Who has completed one year’s course of electrician or radio mechanic or wireman motor rewinding conducted by the director of cottage industries.
